ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; visible surface is approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels and 15% low-intensity black/grey pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixels form the primary mass of both fluke lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous perimeter along the trailing edge and distal tips. A dense cluster of mottled dark pixels is vertically oriented in the central region around the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel-calculated angle of 52 degrees and a significant depth relative to the horizontal lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High frequency of irregular serrations along the trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations are most pronounced at the distal tips, creating a jagged, saw-tooth boundary against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a convex curve sweeping posteriorly and then anteriorly toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible: three parallel diagonal lines on the mid-left lobe and several sparse vertical marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of dark linear rake marks across the high-intensity white surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly concentrated zone of dark, non-uniform mottled pixels localized at the fluke-peduncle insertion point.
